items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 117-120 (book Lemma 3.1.8): if a type is a set then it is a 1-type. The statement is a level implication whose verification requires comparing paths between paths, and the proof (source lines 121-128) has to produce that comparison: it fixes a path p, turns the set-ness proof into a dependent function on paths out of p, applies its dependent action on paths to a path r between two such paths, computes the resulting dependent path through the transport rule in a path family into an explicit concatenation identity, and then cancels a common factor to conclude that any two paths between p and q coincide. The cancellation step and the transport computation are the content and neither is visible in the statement.
